10.5067/GPM/IMERGDL/DAY/07

claims.text: V07 (minor version V07B per GES DISC) is the current Late Run version, but since March 2026 it runs in a 'hybrid' mode: the V07 algorithm ingesting GPROF V08, with climatological CORRA calibration; the switch to V08 is expected no sooner than winter 2026, and no V08 release was found as of 2026-11-20.

evidence.passage: Version 07B is the current version of the IMERG data sets.
Already, IMERG V07 Late and Early are operating in “hybrid” mode, using the IMERG V07 algorithm but ingesting GPROF V08.
Starting March 1, the CORRA calibration has been set to climatological values that are periodically updated to reflect seasonal conditions.
The projected switch for the Late and Early Runs will take place no sooner than winter of 2026

claims.text: IMERG combines passive-microwave estimates (GPROF, intercalibrated to the GPM CORRA radar-radiometer product), morphed in time with model-derived motion vectors and blended with IR estimates in a Kalman filter; the Late Run uses forward and backward morphing, the Early forward only.

evidence.passage: computed using the 2021 version of the Goddard Profiling Algorithm (GPROF2021), then gridded, intercalibrated to the GPM Combined Ku Radar-Radiometer Algorithm (CORRA) product
The KF uses the morphed data as the “forecast” and the IR estimates as the “observations”
"Late" multi-satellite product ~14 hr after observation time, using both forward and backward morphing
